Practice areas

How we can help

Choose an area to see what we do, and when clients usually call us.

  • 01 Corporate & CommercialCompany formation, shareholder agreements, acquisitions and disposals, joint ventures and the commercial contracts that run your business day to day.
  • 02 Disputes & LitigationCommercial disputes, contract claims, debt recovery and arbitration. We aim to resolve matters early and are ready to go to court when we need to.
  • 03 Banking & FinanceLending and security, refinancing and restructuring, and financial regulation for borrowers, lenders and investors.
  • 04 Real EstateAcquisitions, leasing, development and property finance for commercial and private clients.
  • 05 EmploymentContracts, policies, workplace investigations, exits and employment claims, for employers and senior executives.
  • 06 Intellectual Property & TechnologyBrand protection, licensing, technology contracts, data protection and privacy compliance.
  • 07 Private Client & FamilyWills, estates, trusts, succession planning and family matters, handled with discretion.
